name: Mercenary Flame Shield
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Flame Shield (players/wizard/mercenary/flame_shield_merc.sval, 14 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 4 (in brackets): a fixed blast (your Blast Wave at its level). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: When Flame Shield takes a hit (50% less damage, 3 s recharge) it sets off its own blast for 30 magical in a 64 radius, with Blast Wave's level-4 slow and confusion, whether or not you have Blast Wave.
